entities.name: Fulmart's Fort
entities.description: A jumble of rocks on a cliff at the edge of Witch's Weir in western Jamuraa, with a river tumbling into the ocean beside it.

entities.name: Buzzard's Bay
entities.description: A port 16 leagues north of Fulmart's Fort.

entities.name: Witch's Weir
entities.description: The southern arm of Buzzard's Bay at whose edge the fort lies.

entities.name: Arboria
entities.description: A forest reachable by following the river upstream from the fort.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent in which Fulmart's Fort lies.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the fort lies.

relations.note: The fort is part of western Jamuraa.
relations.quote: part of western Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria
